user.title: Configure HA Gecko Kiosk
user.description: This integration manages your tablets through Home Assistant's existing MQTT integration. Add the tablets to the same broker first.

abort.already_configured: HA Gecko Kiosk has already been configured.

init.title: Optional private APK update source
init.description: Upload APK files without extra settings in Gecko-kiosken → App-updates. These fields configure an optional GitHub build source. The Actions-read token stays in HA. Leave it blank to preserve the existing token; clear the repository to disable this source.

error.invalid_ota_source: Enter a repository, branch, workflow filename and Actions-read token, or clear the repository to disable OTA.
